reason: In pkg/storage/unified/search/bleve.go:72-141, BuildIndex no longer holds cacheMu across the build and only locks around b.cache[key] = idx (bleve.go:137-139), while getOrCreateIndex (pkg/storage/unified/resource/search.go:287-307) has no locking between GetIndex and build. Concurrent Search and handleEvent callers can therefore run BuildIndex simultaneously for the same key, racing on bleve.New(dir, mapper) (bleve.go:96-98) for file-backed indexes and overwriting b.cache[key] so the losing index goes untracked and any writes to it are lost.
